files.rationale: Took PR B's full root layout (rich metadata, Header, SearchProvider, ProgressBar, GoogleTagManager), which already covers PR A's search-context, NProgress and analytics goals and matches B's search-provider/progress-bar files, so wrapping it in A's Providers as well would duplicate that behavior.

Took PR B's native server-component homepage because PR B deletes the pages directory, so PR A's re-export from '../pages/index' would no longer resolve; B's version still revalidates daily, like A's.
Kept PR A's typed nextConfig object with experimental appDir and PR B's MDX remark/rehype options, and used B's pageExtensions including 'jsx'.

Took PR B's newer dependency versions (MDX 3, husky 9, image-size 1.1.1, lint-staged 15.2.1, plus @next/third-parties and packageManager) and kept PR A's devDependency bumps (prettier 3, shell-quote 1.8), which B did not touch.
